messages:
maya: Morning — quick sync on the new open-model bundle (zephyr-lite + talon-3b). Pulling an abbreviated launch checklist together. CC @samir @liz @jordan. TL;DR: zephyr licensing looks clear, talon needs legal confirmation; perf rerun tonight.

samir: ran a baseline profile on talon-3b yesterday (8x A10G). p95 ~180ms @batch4 seq512. I'll do a follow-up with quant flags tonight.

jordan: legal heads-up — legal requested provenance and third-party weight breakdown for talon. sending draft to @legal-bot now.

legal-bot: Received draft provenance document, beginning checklist. ETA ~48h for full review.

liz: console/metadata note: catalog won't show model until these fields are present: training_data, license_url, safety_notes. @maya need those for talon.

maya: I'll fill training_data + safety_notes tonight. license_url for talon blocked until legal signs off.

samir: perf rerun scheduled at 22:00 PT. trying quantization flags: --quant=q4_0 and --use-fused-attn. CLI: ```bench --model talon-3b --batch 4 --seq 512 --quant q4_0```

jordan: small registry schema issue: sample_rate expected int but some manifests have '16k'. opened quick PR: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/432

maya: Ownership summary for clarity: zephyr-lite -> metadata: @liz, perf: @samir, legal handoff: @jordan. talon-3b -> perf: @samir, legal: @jordan, metadata: @maya.

liz: metadata PR (#427) is up — need a quick review for a few additional fields and safety copy. Can someone glance?

samir: will review in ~30m. noted manifest size mismatch (reported 12.1GB vs actual 11.9GB) — will push correction in same PR.

legal-bot: quick question for talon: license mentions third-party segment under CC-BY — need explicit redistribution permission for weights. @jordan can you confirm source and rights?

jordan: digging into upstream. base code Apache-2.0, weights include CC-BY portion. escalating to legal review and adding details to the provenance doc.

liz: launch milestone target: internal beta visibility Fri EOD. Any blockers to call out now? :eyes: 

maya: current blockers: talon licensing, talon perf needs tonight's run, schema fix in registry. If legal clears by Thu AM and perf passes, internal beta Friday looks doable; otherwise push to next week.

samir: early perf signal is better with q4_0 — latency down ~15%. will post precise numbers when job completes and push csv to the bench-results sheet. If we still need faster response for hosted routes we can limit max_seq for talon in hosted offering.

jordan: legal ETA 36-48h. I'll follow up and add formal sign-off comment on the PR once cleared.

liz: setting up canary route for internal testing: /models/open/talon-3b/canary — internal-only traffic. Will toggle when metadata and legal flags are OK.

maya: adding a minimal test plan to run after perf completes: ```- smoke generate 50 queries @seq128
- record p50/p95, token cost
- safety eval: run 200 prompts from safety-suite
- do not enable public downloads until legal sign-off```

samir: copied test plan; bench job started. will attach results and logs here when done. ping me if you want CSV to be shared with PMs.

jordan: added legal comments to the catalog PR and created issue #998 for provenance docs and follow-ups.

liz: thanks. plan: if no major issues, I'll flip internal beta toggle Friday 10:00 PT. please ack if that's okay. :thumbsup: 

maya: ack — I'll finish metadata + safety notes tonight and post final check.

samir: ack.

jordan: ack — will chase legal.

legal-bot: Noted. Will post final sign-off here once checklist completes.
